description: [ferryhopper] Deprecated: prefer search_ferry_trips, which covers this tool plus round-trip and multi-leg search and per-segment availability flags. Get a list of available one-way ferry trips between two ports on a specific date.

arrivalLocation.description: Arrival location as a human-readable name or search term (e.g. city, port name), not a port code.

date.description: Departure date in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2026-03-15).

departureLocation.description: Departure location as a human-readable name or search term (e.g. city, port name), not a port code.
